newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Telepri considers public offering in Telecel.
newsitem.headline: Telepri considers public offering in Telecel.

text.p: Portugal's Telepri- Telecomunicacoes Privadas SGPS SA is considering an initial public offering of shares in Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel Comunicacoes Pessoais SA, said SBC Warburg, one of the global coordinators.
Telepri, a joint holding company of the Espirito Santo and Amorim groups, now holds 75 percent of the issued share capital of Telecel, a statement said.
"It is expected that the shares would be listed on the Lisbon stock exchange," SBC Warburg said.
The shares offered would be existing shares currently held by Telepri, it said.
The planned offering would be directed towards Portuguese and foreign institutional investors and the Portuguese public.
The shareholders of Telecel will decide in the next few weeks when and how the offering can best be executed, SBC Warburg said.
SBC Warburg, Lehman Brothers and Portugal's Banco Essi have been appointed global coordinators in respect of the global offering.
Banco ESSI will coordinate sales in Portugal, and Lehman Brothers and SBC Warburg will coordinate sales to international investors.
